title: Constrained Command-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning with Bandit Strategy Selection in Real-Time Strategy Games
title_zh: Constrained Command-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning with Bandit Strategy Selection in Real-Time Strategy Games

paragraphs.en: Deep reinforcement learning agents reach strong performance in real-time strategy games but can be brittle against opponents outside their training distribution. Separating strategic command selection from learned unit control allows different strategies to be selected for different opponents while reusing the same execution policy. This requires an executor that can follow different commands and measurable criteria for assessing whether it does so. We introduce a constrained command-conditioned Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) policy, the executor, for MicroRTS, a real-time strategy environment. Discrete commands specify strategic objectives and behavioral requirements for economy, army composition, military posture, and worker policy over multiple environment steps; the executor determines the unit-level actions used to fulfill them. A Thompson-sampling bandit acts as the strategist, selecting command tuples from an estimate of the opponent’s strategy built from in-game observations rather than opponent identity. In a controlled comparison with a flat PPO baseline trained with the same architecture, budget, curriculum and self-play league, the strategist–executor system wins significantly more often against three of the four strongest opponents on a training map, including the two strongest held-out ones (0.55 → 0.97 and 0.01 → 0.34), with no significant difference against the others.
paragraphs.zh: 深度强化学习智能体在即时战略游戏中表现出色，但面对超出其训练分布的对手时可能显得脆弱。 将战略指令选择与学习到的单位控制分离，使得系统能够针对不同对手选择不同的策略，同时复用相同的执行策略。 这需要一个能够遵循不同指令的执行器，以及用于评估其执行效果的可衡量标准。 我们为 MicroRTS（一个即时战略环境）引入了一种受约束的、以指令为条件的近端策略优化（PPO）策略——执行器。 离散指令会指定多个环境步骤中经济、军队构成、军事姿态和工人政策方面的战略目标与行为要求；执行器则决定用于实现这些目标的单位级动作。 一个采用汤普森采样的多臂老虎机模型充当策略制定者，它基于游戏内观察而非对手身份来构建对手策略的估计值，并据此选择指令元组。 在与使用相同架构、预算、课程和自对弈联赛训练的扁平化 PPO 基线模型的控制性对比中，策略制定者–执行器系统在训练地图上的四个最强对手中有三个面前获胜频率显著更高，包括两个最强的未参与训练的对手（胜率从 0.55 提升至 0.97，以及从 0.01 提升至 0.34），而对其他对手则没有显著差异。

paragraphs.en: Real-time strategy (RTS) games have been a challenging benchmark for showcasing advances in Reinforcement Learning (RL), with exemplary applications such as OpenAI Five ( OpenAI et al., 2019b ) and DeepMind’s AlphaStar ( Vinyals et al., 2019b ) . Although these agents often reach superhuman performance, they still have limitations in several areas. First, while some post-hoc analysis of learned strategies is possible ( OpenAI, 2018 ) , it remains difficult to understand why these agents make particular decisions or to directly steer their behavior. Secondly, these agents show strategic brittleness: they become optimized against recent training opponents but fail against strategies they have not encountered recently. This is typically addressed by maintaining a diverse population of agents during self-play training ( Vinyals et al., 2019a ) , which makes robustness a property of the training distribution rather than something the agent can adapt at play time.
paragraphs.zh: 实时策略（RTS）游戏一直是展示强化学习（RL）进展的具有挑战性的基准，其典范应用包括 OpenAI Five（OpenAI 等，2019b）和 DeepMind 的 AlphaStar（Vinyals 等，2019b）。 尽管这些智能体通常能达到超人类水平的表现，但在某些方面仍存在局限性。 首先，虽然可以对已学习的策略进行一些事后分析（OpenAI，2018），但要理解这些智能体为何做出特定决策或直接引导其行为仍然十分困难。 其次，这些智能体表现出策略上的脆弱性：它们针对近期的训练对手进行了优化，但面对近期未接触过的策略时却会失效。 通常通过自我对弈训练期间维持一个多样化的智能体群体来解决这一问题（Vinyals 等，2019a），这使得鲁棒性成为训练分布的特性，而非智能体在游戏过程中能够自适应的能力。

paragraphs.en: Separating strategic choice from unit control is the logical answer to both problems, but existing separations each sacrifice something. Hierarchical RL ( Dayan and Hinton, 1992 ; Bugeja et al., 2019 ) makes the goal explicit, yet rewards following it with a bonus that, in an adversarial game, trades off directly against winning, and gives no criterion for whether it was followed at all. Portfolio-based search and programmatic strategies ( Churchill and Buro, 2013 ; Mariño et al., 2021 ) provide an interpretable and verifiable choice space, but rely on scripted execution that cannot match learned policies in unit-level control.
paragraphs.zh: 将战略选择与单位控制分离是解决这两个问题的逻辑性答案，但现有的分离方法各有其牺牲之处。 层次强化学习（Dayan 和 Hinton，1992；Bugeja 等，2019）明确提出了这一目标，但通过奖励机制给予遵循该目标的额外加分，在对抗性游戏中，这种加分会与获胜直接产生权衡，并且并未提供任何判断是否真正遵循了该目标的标准。 基于投资组合的搜索和程序化策略（Churchill 和 Buro，2013；Mariño 等，2021）提供了一个可解释且可验证的选择空间，但它们依赖于脚本化的执行方式，无法在单位层面的控制上与学习到的策略相媲美。

paragraphs.en: We introduce a framework for strategic control built around three components: a fixed, human-readable command space with explicit, state-measurable success criteria; an executor trained across commands to maximize game performance subject to a separate success-rate constraint for each command; and a strategist that adjusts command selection in response to observed opponent behavior without retraining the executor. We evaluate the framework in microRTS ( Huang et al., 2021 ) , an RTS environment used in the annual IEEE Conference on Games competitions. We highlight the following main contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种基于三个组件的战略控制框架：一个固定的、人类可读的命令空间，其中包含明确且可衡量状态的成功标准；一个经过多种命令训练的执行器，旨在最大化游戏表现，同时满足每个命令独立的成功率约束；以及一个战略家，它根据观察到的对手行为调整命令选择，而无需重新训练执行器。 我们在 microRTS（Huang 等人，2021）中对该框架进行了评估，这是一个用于年度 IEEE 游戏会议竞赛的实时策略游戏环境。 我们重点介绍以下主要贡献：

paragraphs.en: A command system with measurable outcomes. The strategist selects a four-slot command tuple covering economy, unit composition, military posture, and worker policy, with 16 commands across the four slots. Each command specifies when it may be issued and what the executor must achieve within an execution window, such as producing the requested unit composition. Game-state measurements determine whether the command succeeds, fails, or times out, allowing us to measure how reliably the executor follows each command and, by holding commands fixed, which strategies win against which opponents.
paragraphs.zh: 一个具有可衡量结果的命令系统。 策略制定者选择一个包含四个槽位的命令元组，涵盖经济、单位构成、军事姿态和工人政策，这四个槽位共有 16 个命令。 每个命令都规定了其可执行的时间以及执行者在执行窗口内必须完成的任务，例如生产指定的单位构成。 游戏状态的测量结果会决定命令是成功、失败还是超时，这使我们能够衡量执行者执行每个命令的可靠性，并通过固定命令来观察哪些策略能战胜哪些对手。

paragraphs.en: An observation-based bandit strategist. A bandit strategist learns how well command tuples perform against different opponent behaviors, sharing information across combinations through their individual commands. During training, it explores promising and uncertain combinations using Thompson sampling. During evaluation, the frozen strategist selects command tuples from its learned estimates and the opponent behavior suggested by current observations, without opponent identity or retraining the executor.

paragraphs.en: We first review RTS game AI, mostly developed in StarCraft and MicroRTS, and then more general work on goal-conditioned and hierarchical RL and on strategy selection against unknown opponents.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先回顾了即时战略（RTS）游戏中的智能体研究，这些研究主要基于《星际争霸》和 MicroRTS 展开；随后介绍了更通用的目标条件化和分层强化学习（RL）相关成果，以及针对未知对手的策略选择方法。

paragraphs.en: Pure RL approaches such as AlphaStar ( Vinyals et al., 2019a ) and OpenAI Five ( OpenAI et al., 2019a ) are steered only by retraining; their strategy lives implicitly in the weights. Scripted portfolios and action abstraction make strategic decisions explicit instead. Portfolio Greedy Search assigns each unit a script from a fixed, hand-written portfolio ( Churchill and Buro, 2013 ) ; related methods select one script per unit type ( Lelis, 2017 ) , expose script choice points to look-ahead search ( Barriga et al., 2015 ) , let only a selected subset of units leave script-generated actions ( Moraes and Lelis, 2018 ) , or pair a learned strategic layer with scripted execution ( Barriga et al., 2021 ) . Programmatic-strategy methods synthesize the complete policy as a program in a domain-specific language ( Mariño et al., 2021 ) ; InnateCoder guides this search with foundation-model generated programs and is competitive with past MicroRTS competition winners ( Moraes et al., 2025 ) . In all of these, low-level behavior is specified by scripts or a program space rather than learned. We retain the idea of a small, fixed strategic vocabulary, but each vocabulary item specifies a goal with a state-measurable success criterion, while a learned executor determines how to achieve it.

paragraphs.en: A closely related approach in RTS games is Grounded RL ( Xu et al., 2022 ) , which uses constrained RL to learn to win while following human commands. It measures command adherence indirectly by bounding the behavior-cloning loss on human demonstrations. Our approach instead measures adherence through explicit success criteria defined in terms of the game state. Each command in a fixed, human-readable vocabulary has its own success-rate target, with a separate Lagrange multiplier adapted to measured shortfalls. The executor learns to meet these targets through interaction, without human demonstrations.

paragraphs.en: Selecting among reusable behaviors provides a way to respond to an unfamiliar opponent without learning an entire policy from scratch. Bayesian Policy Reuse ( Rosman et al., 2016 ) selects from a learned policy library using a belief over task types inferred from observed signals and a model of policy performance. Deep BPR+ ( Zheng et al., 2018 ) extends this approach to non-stationary opponents, identifying response policies from rewards and observed opponent behavior. In RTS games, Gehring et al. (2018) learn to switch among rule-based build orders in StarCraft: Brood War from partial observations, using hidden opponent unit counts as an auxiliary prediction target during training. Bandit methods also operate at a lower decision level: Ontanon (2013) use combinatorial bandits to select combinations of unit actions within Monte Carlo tree search. Our strategist selects compositional command tuples that a single shared policy executes, rather than choosing from separately trained policies or predefined build orders. Payoff evidence is shared across tuples with common commands.
paragraphs.zh: 在可重用的行为中进行选择，提供了一种无需从头学习完整策略即可应对陌生对手的方法。 贝叶斯策略复用（Rosman 等，2016）通过基于观察到的信号推断出的任务类型信念以及对策略性能模型的选择，从已学习的策略库中选取策略。 Deep BPR+（Zheng 等，2018）将这种方法扩展到非平稳对手，通过奖励和观察到的对手行为来识别应对策略。 在 RTS 游戏中，Gehring 等 （2018）通过部分观察学习在《星际争霸：母巢之战》中切换基于规则的建造顺序，并在训练期间将隐藏的敌方单位数量用作辅助预测目标。 多臂老虎机方法也在较低的决策层面上运行：Ontanon（2013）使用组合多臂老虎机在蒙特卡洛树搜索中选择单位行动的组合。 我们的策略制定者选择由单一共享策略执行的组合式命令元组，而不是从单独训练的策略或预定义的建造顺序中进行选择。 具有共同命令的元组之间共享收益证据。

paragraphs.en: The executor is a GridNet ( Han et al., 2019 ) policy trained with PPO ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) . It produces per-cell multi-discrete actions with invalid-action masking ( Huang and Ontañón, 2022 ) . A convolutional encoder and residual blocks ( He et al., 2016 ) produce spatial features; a decoder upsamples these features with a command-gated skip connection to produce per-cell logits. The same policy serves all command tuples. Architecture details are given in Appendix D .

paragraphs.en: During training, the executor may not yet have learned to carry out some commands reliably. Giving these commands a large weight can divert learning from game performance without improving command execution. We therefore use a heuristic guard: if a command’s success rate remains below target and stops improving while its multiplier stays near the upper bound, we temporarily reduce that multiplier to its minimum value. Normal multiplier updates resume once the success rate improves again. The guard does not prove that a target is infeasible or guarantee that it will be met. Settings are given in Appendix F.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 在训练过程中，执行者可能尚未学会可靠地执行某些命令。 若赋予这些命令较大的权重，可能会使学习偏离游戏表现的提升，却无法改善命令的执行效果。 因此，我们采用了一种启发式保护机制：如果某个命令的成功率持续低于目标值且不再提升，同时其乘数接近上限，我们将暂时将该乘数降至最小值。 一旦成功率再次提升，正常的乘数更新便会恢复。 该保护机制既不能证明某个目标不可行，也不能保证该目标一定能达成。 相关设置见附录 F.2。

paragraphs.en: The executor and strategist are trained together from scratch in a single run. Each episode takes commands from either the strategist or a generated schedule (random command tuples switched at preset ticks or game states). Early episodes use schedules only, to cover the command space; the strategist’s share then grows, but a fixed share of schedule episodes remains so the executor keeps practicing tuples the strategist does not select. Both kinds of episodes train the executor and supply scouting evidence and game outcomes to the bandit. A game may use several tuples but yields one outcome, a win or a non-win, which we split among the tuples in proportion to how long each one was active. This avoids crediting only the final tuple but does not identify each tuple’s causal contribution. Affected table rows are discounted before each update, so older results lose weight as the executor changes (Appendix E ).
paragraphs.zh: 执行智能体与策略智能体在一次运行中从零开始共同训练。 每一轮都会接收来自策略智能体或生成计划（在预设的时间点或游戏状态切换的随机命令元组）的命令。 早期轮次仅使用计划以覆盖所有命令空间；随后策略智能体的参与比例逐渐增加，但仍保留固定比例的计划轮次，确保执行智能体能持续练习策略智能体未选择的命令元组。 这两种轮次都会训练执行智能体，并为博弈论中的多臂老虎机模型提供侦察证据与游戏结果。 一局游戏可能使用多个命令元组，但最终只产生一个结果（胜利或非胜利），我们将该结果按各元组活跃时长进行分配。 这种方法避免了仅将功劳归于最后一个命令元组，但并未明确识别每个元组的因果贡献。 受影响的表格行在每次更新前都会被折扣处理，因此随着执行智能体的变化，较旧的结果权重会逐渐降低（附录 E）。

paragraphs.en: A success rate can reach its target while the command has no effect, for three reasons. First, the rate depends on where a command is issued. paragraphs.en: Table 4 reports which commands the strategist issued in the 1 200 1\,200 Bandit games of Table 3 , head-to-head excluded. paragraphs.en: We introduced a constrained command-conditioned strategist–executor system for real-time strategy games. Measurable command criteria encourage a useful behavioral repertoire, per-command adaptive adherence pressure helps maintain it, and the resulting system wins more often than a flat PPO baseline against three of the four strongest opponents, including the two strongest held-out ones, on a training map, and less often against the 2024 competition winner. This gain, however, stems from command-conditioned training rather than from adaptive behavior switching. Intervention tests show that only economy and composition commands change the executor’s behavior, although posture and worker-policy commands also meet their success-rate constraints, and fixed commands chosen with knowledge of the opponent’s identity performs on par with the strategist. The result is a versatile agent with steerable strategies. Because these strategies are named commands, which of them wins against which opponent can be measured directly rather than reconstructed from a post-hoc analysis. The agent does not yet switch well between these strategies during play; a next step is to estimate adherence using interventions rather than success rates.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为实时策略游戏引入了一种受约束的命令条件化战略家-执行者系统。 可量化的命令标准能够促进形成有用的行为库，每条命令的适应性遵循压力有助于维持这一行为库；在训练地图上，该系统与四个最强对手中的三个（包括两个最强的保留对手）相比，获胜频率高于普通的 PPO 基线模型，但与 2024 年竞赛冠军相比则较少获胜。 然而，这种优势源于命令条件化的训练，而非适应性行为切换。 干预测试表明，只有经济和编组类命令会改变执行者的行为，尽管姿态和工人策略类命令也满足其成功率约束；而基于对手身份知识选择的固定命令，其表现与战略家相当。 最终得到的是一个具备可引导策略的多功能智能体。 由于这些策略以命名的命令形式存在，因此它们各自对阵不同对手的胜负可以直接测量，而非通过事后分析进行重构。 该智能体在游戏过程中尚不能在这些策略之间良好切换；下一步是利用干预测试而非成功率来评估其遵循程度。

paragraphs.en: MicroRTS is a minimalist RTS environment designed specifically as a testbed for RL research. The core gameplay loop requires agents to gather resources via worker units to construct buildings and train military units. Workers can construct two structures: a base, which produces additional workers, and a barracks, which produces distinct military classes: light, ranged, and heavy units. Light units are the cheapest units and therefore are often used in strategies focus on early pressure to the opponents. They are the fastest and are therefore considered a counter to ranged units in most situations. Ranged units are also cheap to produce and are able to attack other units or building from a distance. They have few health points however and easily die once light or especially heavy units get near them. Since they outpace heavy units and can stay away from their reach, they are considered a counter to heavy units. Heavy units are the most expensive units, are quite slow and take long to produce. Light units deal little damage to them so they are considered the counter to light units. Episodes typically begin with a base and at least one worker already in place, however there are a few maps where both sides begin with more bases or barracks.
paragraphs.zh: MicroRTS 是一个极简主义的实时策略（RTS）环境，专为强化学习（RL）研究而设计。 核心游戏循环要求智能体通过工人单位收集资源，以建造建筑和训练军事单位。 工人可以建造两种建筑：基地，用于生产更多工人；以及兵营，用于生产不同类型的军事单位：轻型、远程和重型单位。 轻型单位是成本最低的单位，因此常用于专注于对对手施加早期压力的策略中。 它们的速度最快，因此在大多数情况下被视为远程单位的克制单位。 远程单位的生产成本也较低，并且能够从远处攻击其他单位或建筑。 然而，它们的生命值很少，一旦轻型单位，尤其是重型单位靠近，就会轻易被击败。 由于它们的速度超过重型单位且能保持在其攻击范围之外，因此被视为重型单位的克制单位。 重型单位是成本最高的单位，速度相当慢，而且需要较长时间才能生产出来。 轻型单位对它们的伤害很小，因此重型单位被视为轻型单位的克制单位。 游戏回合通常开始时已有一个基地和至少一个工人，但少数地图中双方会从多个基地或兵营开始。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate generalizability, MicroRTS includes a diverse set of maps varying in size, terrain, and resource distribution, requiring distinct macro-strategies to master. Furthermore, the environment features a pool of built-in scripted opponents (such as coacAI , WorkerRush , and LightRush ) of varying algorithmic complexity. These baseline bots provide a natural mechanism for curriculum learning, allowing the RL agent to undergo stepped training against increasingly difficult opponents before facing advanced strategies.

paragraphs.en: The opponents in Table 3 span scripted policies, game-tree search, and deep reinforcement learning. The standard workerRushAI , lightRushAI , heavyRushAI , and rangedRushAI baselines use hand-written policies that emphasize attacks with their respective unit types; the Gym- μ \mu RTS benchmark provides the surrounding evaluation framework ( Huang et al., 2021 ) . paragraphs.en: TMA (TMA, Tactical Manager AI) is in the training pool. TMA won the 2024 competition: it was the highest-ranked submission both on the open maps and on the open and hidden maps combined, and only Mayari and CoacAI baselines placed above it in one of the two rankings ( Mazza, 2024 ; microRTS AI Competition, 2024 ) . TMA is scripted and does not perform any search. It has four hand-written scripts: a worker or military rush, and a worker or military defense. At every step, a controller chooses one of them through two binary decisions based on features of the game state. It chooses a military script rather than a worker script once it has barracks, when resources accumulate or when the enemy is far from its base. The controller then sets the parameters of the selected script from the map size, unit counts and distances. These parameters are the number of harvesting workers, the resource reserve above which the base trains additional workers, and production priorities. The priorities keep the army balanced across light, heavy and ranged units, favor ranged units when no path to the enemy exists, and shift production toward the enemy’s most numerous unit type. TMA can be seen as a hand-written counterpart of the hierarchy studied here, in which a fixed rule chooses a strategy and its parameters and scripted unit behaviors execute it.

paragraphs.en: Military units are classified as offensive or defensive by proximity to observed enemy targets or own bases, barracks, and workers; units approximately equidistant and at least five tiles from both are idle. Offensive mode requires a ≥ 0.40 a\geq 0.40 , o ≥ 0.55 o\geq 0.55 , and o ≥ d o\geq d ; defensive mode requires a < 0.40 a<0.40 or ( d ≥ 0.65 ​ and ​ d > o ) (d\geq 0.65\text{ and }d>o) . Split mode requires a ≥ 0.40 a\geq 0.40 and o , d ≥ 0.20 o,d\geq 0.20 , with neither other mode active. FLANK requires an offensive or defensive core with units on both sides of the own-to-enemy axis: a minority-side unit must have lateral displacement of at least two tiles and normalized forward projection ≥ 0.45 \geq 0.45 for offense or ≤ 0.60 \leq 0.60 for defense. paragraphs.en: The executor learns from five reward streams: one for game performance and one for each command slot. The game reward encourages economic and military progress independently of the current command, while the slot rewards provide feedback on its execution. These streams define separate value targets and are combined only through their normalized advantages, with the command-specific multipliers determining the relative priority of adherence. Terminal command outcomes provide the success-rate estimates used to update those multipliers.
paragraphs.zh: 执行智能体从五个奖励流中学习：一个用于游戏表现，另一个用于每个命令槽。 游戏奖励鼓励经济和军事发展独立于当前命令，而各命令槽的奖励则提供对其执行情况的反馈。 这些奖励流定义了独立的价值目标，仅通过它们的归一化优势进行结合，而特定命令的乘数则决定了遵守命令的相对优先级。 最终命令的结果提供了成功率的估计值，用于更新这些乘数。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 scores each game against several commands of the varied slot, not only the one that was issued, so it uses heuristic behavior scores rather than contract outcomes. From the intervention until the window closes, every compared command receives a score in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] at each tick, computed from the observed state. For economy, GROW scores worker growth since the intervention and whether a base is training workers, and HOLD the absence of both. For composition, a command scores the requested type’s share of the military units produced since the intervention, whether that type was produced at all and whether it is in production, with a penalty while another military type is in production. For posture, OFFENSE scores the fraction of the army beyond 0.45 0.45 of the axis from the mean position of own structures and workers to that of the enemy, and the army’s mean position on that axis, and DEFENSE the fraction within five tiles of own structures and the fraction not beyond 0.45 0.45 . For worker policy, HARASS scores the fraction of workers in the opponent’s half and the fraction attacking, and ECON_ONLY harvesting activity with workers kept home and not attacking. A game’s score for a command is its mean over the ticks at which at least one command of the slot scores above zero; the figure averages over games. These scores agree with the physical metrics of Table 2 : against the same-seed reference, OFFENSE changes none of the four posture scores and HARASS neither worker-policy score by more than 0.04 0.04 on a [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] scale, whereas HEAVY and RANGED raise the score of the requested type by 0.78 0.78 and 0.80 0.80 ( Figure 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 将每场比赛与插槽中多个命令进行评分，而不仅仅是执行的那个命令，因此它使用的是启发式行为得分，而非合同结果。 从干预开始直到窗口关闭，每个被比较的命令在每个时间步都会根据观察到的状态获得一个 [0, 1] 范围内的得分。 为简化起见，GROW 会自干预以来对工人增长以及基地是否在训练工人进行评分；而 HOLD 则对两者均未发生的情况进行评分。 在组成方面，一个命令的得分取决于自干预以来所生产军事单位中所需类型的比例、该类型是否被生产以及是否正在生产中；如果同时有其他军事类型在生产，则会受到惩罚。 在态势方面，OFFENSE 会评分军队中超出从己方建筑和工人的平均位置到敌方平均位置连线 0.45 轴长的军队比例，以及军队在该轴上的平均位置；DEFENSE 则评分位于己方建筑五格范围内的军队比例，以及未超出 0.45 轴长的军队比例。 在工人策略方面，HARASS 会评分处于对手半场的工人比例和正在攻击的工人比例；ECON_ONLY 则评分工人在基地内且未进行攻击时的采集活动。 某一命令在比赛中的得分是其在至少一个插槽命令得分高于零的时间步上的平均值；该图对多场比赛进行了平均计算。 这些得分与表 2 中的物理指标一致：在与相同种子的参考对比中，OFFENSE 未改变四个态势得分中的任何一项，HARASS 也未使任一工人策略得分在 [0, 1] 尺度上变化超过 0.04；而 HEAVY 和 RANGED 则将所需类型的得分分别提升了 0.78 和 0.80（图 2）。

paragraphs.en: To bound what any strategist could gain from choosing commands per opponent, we play the frozen executor of the Bandit arm under every fixed combination of the four economy and six composition commands, with posture and worker policy at DEFENSE and ECON_ONLY . Each of the 24 tuples is held for the whole game against the twelve opponents of Table 3 on map A, with 20 games per cell ( 5 760 5\,760 games). The 18 tuples without HOLD are the Static screen of Appendix I ; they are issuable at the opening and run as written. HOLD requires three workers, so the six HOLD tuples are delivered as in training: GROW until three workers exist, then HOLD , which is not reverted. A game scores 1 for a win, 0.5 for a draw and 0 for a loss. We compare the best single tuple on average with an oracle that uses the best tuple for each opponent, both chosen among the 18 tuples that Static selects from. Because the maximum over 18 noisy cells is biased upward, tuples are selected on half of each cell’s games and scored on the other half, averaged over 2 000 2\,000 random splits, with ties broken at random.
paragraphs.zh: 为了界定任何策略家通过为每个对手选择指令所能获得的收益上限，我们在四种经济和六种组成指令的每一种固定组合下，都采用“强盗臂”的冻结执行器进行游戏，同时将其姿态和工人策略设为 DEFENSE 和 ECON_ONLY。 在地图 A 上，针对表 3 中的十二位对手，每个 24 元组在整个游戏中均被保留，每格进行 20 局游戏（即 5,760 局游戏）。 不含 HOLD 的 18 个元组构成了附录 I 中的静态界面；这些元组可在开局时发布，并按原样运行。 HOLD 需要三名工人，因此六个 HOLD 元组的执行方式与训练时相同：先执行 GROW 直到拥有三名工人，然后执行 HOLD，且该状态不会被撤销。 一局游戏若获胜则得 1 分，平局得 0.5 分，失败则得 0 分。 我们将最佳单个元组的平均表现与一个“神谕”进行比较：该神谕会从静态界面选出的 18 个元组中，为每个对手选择最佳元组。 由于对 18 个存在噪声的单元格取最大值会导致结果偏高，因此每个元组的选取基于每格游戏的一半数据，而得分则基于另一半数据；整个过程在 2,000 次随机划分中取平均数，并在出现平局时以随机方式决出胜负。

paragraphs.en: The choice of commands matters against the strongest opponents. Against RAISocketAI, agent_sota, obiBotKenobi, coacAI and lightRushAI, the worst tuple scores between 0.00 0.00 and 0.50 0.50 and the best between 0.55 0.55 and 1.00 1.00 ; against the other seven opponents, every tuple without HOLD scores at least 0.70 0.70 . Table 11 shows that the best composition also depends on the opponent. RANGED scores 1.00 1.00 against coacAI and 0.11 0.11 against obiBotKenobi, while HEAVY scores 0.00 0.00 against coacAI and above 0.96 0.96 against six other opponents. Nevertheless the oracle gains little. Selected and scored on the same games, which favors the oracle, it scores 0.954 0.954 against 0.921 0.921 for the best single tuple ( GROW , LIGHT ), a difference of 0.033 0.033 , of which 0.021 0.021 comes from coacAI. Out of sample the difference is − 0.011 -0.011 , with 95% of splits between − 0.062 -0.062 and + 0.029 +0.029 ; including the HOLD tuples gives − 0.015 -0.015 . The reason is that LIGHT is the best composition, or within 0.02 0.02 of it, against every opponent except coacAI, so knowing the opponent pays only there, by switching to RANGED .
paragraphs.zh: 面对最强的对手时，指令的选择至关重要。 在面对 RAISocketAI、agent_sota、obiBotKenobi、coacAI 和 lightRushAI 时，最差元组得分介于 0.00 0.00 至 0.50 0.50 之间，最佳得分则介于 0.55 0.55 至 1.00 1.00 之间；而面对其他七位对手时，所有不含 HOLD 的元组得分均至少为 0.70 0.70。 表 11 显示，最佳组合也取决于对手。 RANGED 在对抗 coacAI 时得分为 1.00 1.00，而在对抗 obiBotKenobi 时得分为 0.11 0.11；HEAVY 在对抗 coacAI 时得分为 0.00 0.00，而在对抗其他六位对手时得分均高于 0.96 0.96。 尽管如此，预言机获得的收益微乎其微。 在相同的游戏局面上进行选择和评分（这对预言机更有利），其得分是 0.954 0.954，而最佳单元组（GROW, LIGHT）的得分为 0.921 0.921，两者相差 0.033 0.033，其中 0.021 0.021 来自 coacAI。 在样本外数据中，差异为 −0.011 -0.011，95% 的分割结果介于 −0.062 -0.062 至 +0.029 +0.029 之间；若包含 HOLD 元组，则差异为 −0.015 -0.015。 原因在于，除了 coacAI 之外，面对所有其他对手时，LIGHT 都是最佳组合，或者与最佳组合的差异在 0.02 0.02 以内；因此，只有当知道对手是 coacAI 时，通过切换到 RANGED 才能获得优势。

paragraphs.en: All experiments ran on one server with two NVIDIA H100 NVL GPUs and two AMD EPYC 9534 CPUs (128 cores). Each training run used one GPU for the network and CPU cores for the Java MicroRTS environments. Training to 240M learner steps took approximately 120 h for Flat and 180 h for Bandit, with average throughputs of about 550 and 360 learner transitions per second, respectively. Both runs trained concurrently and shared the machine with other jobs, so these wall-clock times are indicative rather than controlled measurements.
paragraphs.zh: 所有实验均在一台服务器上运行，该服务器配备了两块 NVIDIA H100 NVL GPU 和两颗 AMD EPYC 9534 CPU（128 核）。 每次训练运行中，网络使用一块 GPU，而 Java MicroRTS 环境则使用 CPU 核心。 训练至 240M 个学习者步数时，Flat 模式大约需要 120 小时，Bandit 模式则需要 180 小时，平均吞吐量分别约为每秒 550 和 360 个学习者转换。 两次运行是并行训练的，并且与其他任务共享机器资源，因此这些实际运行时间仅为参考值，而非受控测量结果。
